milestones.name: Foundations
milestones.exit: `npm run dev` opens a window with a fixed-timestep loop running, and CI is green.

milestones.name: Game feel
milestones.exit: One room, one enemy type, and it is **fun to shoot things** — verified by someone else playing it without being told what to do.

milestones.name: Rooms and floors
milestones.exit: A full procedurally generated floor, walkable start to boss room, with a minimap.

milestones.name: Items and synergy
milestones.exit: 25+ items in pools, and two randomly chosen items produce a combination nobody explicitly authored.

milestones.name: Promille
milestones.exit: Promille is a decision the player thinks about, not a bar they ignore.

milestones.name: Floors 1 & 2 content
milestones.exit: Both chapters playable end to end — tilesets, rooms, both enemy rosters and both bosses. Content complete, not yet finished.

milestones.name: Look and motion
milestones.exit: Nothing on screen is a placeholder and everything alive is animated — a stranger watching a clip cannot tell which parts are unfinished.

milestones.name: Meta-progression
milestones.exit: Losing a run makes you want to start another one immediately.

milestones.name: Sound, menus and balance
milestones.exit: It looks and sounds like a finished commercial game.

milestones.name: Floors 3-7
milestones.exit: A complete run from cellar to Die Bavaria.
milestones.parked: deferred until floors 1 & 2 are finished to a commercial standard. Whatever quality bar M6-M8 set for two floors is the bar these five inherit, so building them first would mean building them twice.

criticalPathNote: Critical path to a playable build — the point where the only question that matters, *is this fun?*, becomes answerable.
